notes: Link targets for blog posts. Shared by src/lib/blog-links.ts (the 'Tools and guides for this topic' block rendered under every post) and scripts/link-blog-posts.mjs (the inline-link pass). 'match' regexes score relevance for the block; 'inline' regexes are the stricter phrases the script may wrap in a link. 'match' regexes are case-insensitive; 'inline' regexes are CASE-SENSITIVE (so a lowercase 'cc check' is never linked as a product name) and spell out [Aa] where either case is fine. 'avoidCategories' (lowercase) and 'avoidLine' (regex, case-insensitive) stop a link where the post's wording describes the product differently than its feature page. No competitor names: public pages never name competitors.
